chapter_title: Concerning the Interpretation of the Fourteen [Great Aeons] of Light, about which Sethel has spoken in [his Prayer]
chapter_note: Core teaching dominates from ¶3–¶5: a systematic fourteenfold cosmological enumeration (5+2+5+2) and its function in sustaining/establishing the universe. ¶1–¶2 are compilation frame (disciples’ question + dialogue attribution). ¶5 is more expansive and lacunose, but it remains within the cosmic system (Ambassador’s kingship among aeons) rather than pivoting to contemporary institutions or exhortation.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Hagiographic/dialogue frame: disciples questioning, honorific address (“our master”), request formula, and quotation setup for Sethel’s prayer.
Dialogue attribution (“Then the enlightener speaks…”) and a programmatic promise to interpret; no actual cosmological exposition yet.

paragraphs.core_text: ⟨p.43⟩ Happen you know this, that the [ ... ] below abide in fourteen [great aeons ...]: the five elements, the sons of the First Man, together with the Call and the Hearing. They anoint them, living in them. These shall make seven, five plus two.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic enumerative teaching in an impersonal explanatory voice; cosmic beings/degrees counted and summed (5+2=7) with no appeal to institutions or audience exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text: [ ... the] f[ive s]ons of the Living Spirit who [support] all [the wei]ght of the universe; together with the [Li]vi[ng] Spirit [and the Fir]st Man, their fathers. These are the fourt[een p]raises that he has proclaimed, the praise that is made of fourteen pra[yers], by which the universe is established.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the fourteenfold structure by adding another 5+2; remains cosmos→cosmos (sons, fathers, universe-support mechanics). The ‘fourteen prayers/praises’ language reads as interpretive but still internal to cosmological architecture.

paragraphs.core_text: [There are fourt]een aeons of light [ ... ] of Seth [e] ... ] about them in his prayer, for they are expl[ai]ned [ ... the la]nd that is not revealed. This land [ ... ... is estab]lished. They bore up under the Enemy [ ... ... equa]ls them. The hidden plenitude that [ ... ] the Ambassador who came from the Father, the [ ... ] He came and stood firm in the midst of these [ ... ]: he is called the good father of [all] the ae[ons and gods] who are holy and conjoined. He has become leader and a great king after the likeness of the first Father, the lord of all these cou[nse]ls. This universe is held together by their will [ ... ] to the end of all things.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmological-redemptive exposition: the aeons as underpinning the (hidden/visible) universe and the Ambassador’s enthronement among them. Despite mention of Seth’s prayer, the paragraph does not pivot to community rules, polemic about contemporary cults, or direct address; it stays within the Manichaean cosmic hierarchy (Father/Ambassador/aeons). Lacunae make fine-grained stratification uncertain.
